notes.subject: ntho e thata
notes.rationale: קשה 'e thata/e boima' — ketso e bonahalang e fetohileng sebopeho sa lebitso, jwalo ka 'hard thing' kapa 'hardship'

notes.subject: תרעלה
notes.rationale: lentswe le teng mona feela ho Tanakh — 'ho inama-inama', ho fofa motsotso

notes.subject: הראיתה
notes.rationale: 'o bontshitse' (hiphil wa ראה) kgahlanong le 'o etsetseng ho bona' — ditaba tse thata tse bontshitsweng setjhabeng

translation: O bontshitse setjhaba sa hao ntho e thata; o re fereketse veine ya ho inama-inama.
